props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: TextLinkExternalIcon
description: The ↗ after a link that leaves Raft (design/patterns/navigation.md#links-that-leave-raft): 0.857em (12px at 14px text, as the icons in a reference chip), 2px after the text, centred on the letters' cap height at every text size (0.7em/2 above the baseline; design/foundations/alignment.md#a-mark-that-leads-text). It sits in an inline-flex box, so the link's underline stops at the text and never runs under the arrow.

props.name: label
props.description: Read by a screen reader after the link text, such as "(opens in a new tab)". Product copy, so the caller passes it.
